record_identity.title: Zhipu extraction pipeline harvested and cleaned Claude reasoning traces

incident_identity.date_basis: Anthropic's 10 September 2026 report covers activity through August 2026. The specified date is a source-attributed period indicator, not an independently verified exact event day.

summary: Anthropic reports Zhipu used hundreds of fraudulent accounts and a Claude chain-of-thought extraction workflow to obtain protected reasoning traces and replay them for cleaning and training use. The report attributes over 3.4 million exchanges during June and July; a later cyber-capability campaign is distinct.
